cases.prompt: Refactor this two-step Perl method; there is no reuse or introspection need.
expected: Consider retaining a normal method.
Do not introduce a full workflow engine solely to shorten syntax.

cases.prompt: My role shim calls MainDSL::step(@_) and the registry owner is the shim.
expected: Explain the ordinary call-frame change.
Offer goto & for transparent compatibility or explicit-owner forwarding.
Add a role-owner regression test.

cases.prompt: Design new Moose class and role sugar without fragile caller depth.
expected: Prefer with_meta and one explicit-owner registration backend.
Keep the role entry point distinct from the class entry point.

cases.prompt: A subclass sees inherited methods but none of its parent workflow steps.
expected: Inspect parent-class registry traversal separately from inherited role discovery.
Do not promise calculate_all_roles provides scheduling order.

cases.prompt: Each body calls a blocking command, then returns Future->done($result). Is it parallel?
expected: State that wrapping does not make blocking bodies concurrent.
Identify the need for nonblocking adapters or workers.
Mention cancellation and resource limits.

cases.prompt: Resume a checkpoint after inputs and implementation have changed because all step keys still match.
expected: Reject key-only compatibility.
Require run/input/plan/revision validation.
Discuss the side-effect-to-checkpoint crash window.

cases.prompt: Support arbitrary condition strings by eval, since the inputs came from a tool schema.
expected: Do not use string eval.
Propose a bounded parser or structured condition.
Separate schema validation from authorization.

cases.prompt: A predicate reads the result of the preceding step; compute the exact active count before execution.
expected: Identify a dynamic gate, not a pure preflight predicate.
Do not execute bodies to count them.
Choose an honest dynamic or declared-step progress policy.

cases.prompt: Make this shared enum schema nullable without changing any consumer using the original schema.
expected: Create a detached schema union or an equivalently correct transformation.
Do not only append null to type while leaving enum restrictive.
Test null versus omission.

cases.prompt: make_immutable ran but $obj->step is still callable.
expected: Separate immutability from namespace cleanup and registry sealing.
Use and test the matching DSL cleanup or namespace cleaner.

cases.prompt: Describe the exact current par_group implementation of our task DSL using only this design note.
expected: Say the notes are not a source-code audit.
Inspect the actual repository when accessible.
Distinguish described behavior from proposed improvements.

cases.prompt: Build a list of setup tools by requiring uploaded Perl modules in the admin server.
expected: Identify module loading as arbitrary code execution.
Use a trusted manifest or isolated approved inspection.
Keep tool authorization separate from declarative metadata.
